title: Egypt and Israel sign the Camp David Accords
summary: After 13 days of talks at Camp David, Anwar Sadat and Menachem Begin signed frameworks for peace at the White House, witnessed by Jimmy Carter.
reason: Sadat's visit to Jerusalem and Carter's mediation brought the leaders together.
significance: They led to the Egypt and Israel peace treaty of 1979.
place: White House, Washington, D.C., United States
